commands.name: audit

arguments.name: path
arguments.description: A folder inside the env. The nem.json is looked up  from there upwards.

commands.description: Lists the known vulnerabilities in the env's  installed tools. 'nem install' only prints the count.

commands.name: init

arguments.name: nodeVersion
arguments.description: The Node version the env is initialized for. Partial  versions ("22", "18.12") resolve to the newest matching  release.

arguments.name: path
arguments.description: The path of the folder the env is created in.

commands.description: Creates a nem env (nem.json + .nenv folder) for a  project.

commands.name: install

options.name: --clean
options.description: If set, removes the cached download and the env folder before installing.

arguments.name: path
arguments.description: A folder inside the env. The nem.json is looked up  from there upwards.

commands.description: Downloads/copies the Node version and installs tool  proxies from nem.json.

commands.name: run

arguments.name: toolName
arguments.description: The tool to run. Pass its arguments after a  '--' separator.

commands.description: Runs a tool from the nem env (or the system fallback).  Tool arguments follow the tool name.

commands.name: setup

options.name: --uninstall
options.description: Undoes the setup: takes the nem proxy directory back  out of your PATH and deletes the proxies. The env folders and caches are left  alone.

commands.description: Adds the nem proxy directory to your PATH. Only needs to  be run once; '--uninstall' takes it back out.

commands.name: tool
add

arguments.name: package
arguments.description: The npm package to install into the env, e.g.  'ts-node' or 'ts-node@10.9.0'.

commands.description: Records an npm package in nem.json (it is installed by 'nem install'), e.g. 'nem tool add ts-node@10.9.0'.

commands.name: list
commands.description: Lists the tools of the env.

commands.name: remove

arguments.name: toolName
arguments.description: The npm package to remove from the env.

commands.description: Removes an npm package from the env.
Manages the tools of the env of the current directory.

commands.name: update

options.name: --tools
options.description: When updating the Node version, also update all tools  to the newest versions it supports.

arguments.name: what
arguments.description: What to update: a Node version (e.g. '22' or '18.12.0'), a tool package (e.g. 'typescript' or  '@angular/cli@22'), or 'all' for the Node version and every  tool. Omit to review and update interactively.

arguments.name: path
arguments.description: A folder inside the env. The nem.json is looked up  from there upwards.

commands.description: Updates the env: a Node version ('22'), a tool  ('typescript', '@angular/cli@22'), or 'all'.  Without arguments it reviews the available updates interactively.
